prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Keep & Sync Your Pets", "Signing into your account ensures your pet data, adoption history, and custom settings are safely saved and synced across devices.", "Use your registered email to preserve existing pet progress."]
1: ["Your Pet is Getting Ready!", "Quick Tip: Drag your pet anywhere on screen, or right-click to reveal pet options and settings."]
2: ["Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop", "Your desktop companion is ready! Review these core shortcuts to interact with your pet.", "Drag pet to move | Right-click for settings menu | Double-click to talk"]
3: ["Choose Your Starting Companion", "Pick a companion to join your desktop workflow.", "Adopt Companion"]
4: ["Select Your Onboarding Path", "Choose whether to adopt a pre-made pet or generate a custom creation."]
5: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Desktop pets live right on your screen to keep you company and assist daily tasks."]
6: ["Upload Pet Photo for Custom Generation", "For best accuracy, upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward.", "Tip: Clear front-facing photos yield the most realistic pet creation."]
7: ["Creating Your Pet in the Background", "We will notify you as soon as your pet is ready to join your desktop!"]
8: ["Desktop Pet Controls at a Glance", "Your pet lives directly on top of desktop windows. Right-click anytime to access settings, hide the pet, or interact.", "Got It!"]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Official Adoption Seal"]
